Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You seize your friend’s hand and give a painful measure of your own strength to keep them here.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
An adjacent willing creature, after it enters Dying and its wound is resolved.
Duration
Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Recovery

Pay 7 HP first, leaving yourself above 0; the payment bypasses resistance. With a free hand, restore 8 HP before Life resistance, minimum 1. The wound still occurs. This cannot reverse Last Words. The cost makes this urgent rescue different from an ordinary large heal.
